# Thanksgiving Crafts with Cricut: Easy Projects for Kids, Tables, and Gifts


-
-
-


10 November 2026


[Beth Baty](https://cricut.com/blog/author/bethb/)


---


Cricut makes it easy for the whole family to join in and create special Thanksgiving crafts for Thanksgiving Day. Make kids’ printables, turkey crafts, banners, shirts, and simple table decor with a few materials and a little creative time. Whether you’re crafting with little ones, making a thoughtful hostess gift, or adding a personal touch to the celebration, there are plenty of Cricut Thanksgiving projects to make your gathering feel even more memorable.


Looking for even more seasonal inspiration? Visit our[Thanksgiving inspiration page](https://cricut.com/blog/inspiration/seasonal/holidays/thanksgiving/) for projects, hosting ideas, and how-tos.


## Easy Thanksgiving crafts for kids


Thanksgiving crafts for kids are a fun way to keep little hands busy while making room for gratitude, imagination, and a little holiday excitement. Prep the cutting ahead of time, then let kids color, glue, write, and assemble at their own pace.


### Coloring placemats and activity sheets


**Best for:** Ages 3+ with adult prep


Give the kids’ table its own creative moment with Thanksgiving coloring placemats and activity sheets. Use your Cricut cutting machine’s drawing function to make placemats and activity packs with coloring areas, simple games, and “I’m thankful for…” prompts. These crafts are an easy activity to set out before the meal on Thanksgiving Day, and they’ll keep the kids busy while the adults talk and prep the food.


**Materials**


**Cricut tools and materials:**


- [Drawn Thanksgiving Activity Placemats](https://design-beta.cricut.com/home/inspiration-page-image-sets/6745947?navStateForLeftNavMenuOnCanvasTab=%252Fhome%252Fsearch%252Fsets-of-images&searchQuery=) image set in Design Space
- Cricut cutting machine


- Use[Cricut Joy Xtra](https://cricut.com/en-us/cutting-machines/cricut-joy/cricut-joy-xtra/cricut-joy-xtra/2010313.html) if you’d like your placemats to be on 8.5 × 11 in cardstock or copy paper
- Use[Cricut Explore 5](https://cricut.com/en-us/cutting-machines/cricut-explore/cricut-explore-5/cricut-explore-5-essential-bundle/2012404.html) or[Cricut Maker 5](https://cricut.com/en-us/cutting-machines/cricut-maker/cricut-maker-5/cricut-maker-5-essential-bundle/2012944.html) if you’d like to use 12 in cardstock


- [Cricut® Fine Point Pens](https://cricut.com/en-us/tools-accessories/machine-tools/pens-markers/cricut-fine-point-pens-0.4-mm-black-2-ct-adapter/2012410.html)
- [Cricut LightGrip Machine Mat](https://cricut.com/en-us/tools-accessories/machine-tools/machine-mats)


**Other materials:**


- [White paper or cardstock](https://cricut.com/en-us/compare)
- Crayons, colored pencils, or washable markers


### Turkey crafts for kids


**Best for:** Ages 4+ with pieces pre-cut by an adult and adult help for assembly, when necessary


Turkey crafts are a Thanksgiving classic for good reason: they’re easy to prep and endlessly customizable for any age! Simply use your Cricut cutting machine to cut out some paper turkey pieces and feathers from colorful cardstock, then let the kids create their very own paper turkey, turkey headband, or feather name tag.


For an easy group activity, cut several feather shapes in fall colors. Each person can write their name or something they’re thankful for on a feather before adding it to one big family turkey!


**Materials**


**Cricut tools and materials:**


- Cricut cutting machine
- [Cricut LightGrip machine mat](https://cricut.com/en-us/tools-accessories/machine-tools/machine-mats)


**Other materials:**


- [Colorful cardstock or kraft paper](https://cricut.com/en-us/materials/material-type/paper-cards/cardstock)
- Tape or glue
- Crayons, markers, or colored pencils


### Gratitude cards and thankful trees


**Best for:** Ages 3+ (toddlers can add doodles or dictate their message for an adult to write)


Turn a simple craft into a meaningful family tradition with gratitude cards or a thankful tree/wreath! Use your Cricut cutting machine to cut out some paper leaves from Design Space, then invite everyone to add a note about what they appreciate. Display the finished leaves on a paper tree or wreath throughout the day, and suddenly you’ve got a family activity turned decoration! Or, for older kids and adults, make a few simple Thanksgiving insert cards for everyone to write in, and then host a card swap!


**Materials**


**Cricut tools and materials:**


- Cricut cutting machine
- [Insert Cards](https://cricut.com/en-us/materials/material-type/paper-cards/insert-cards)
- [Cricut Pens or Markers](https://cricut.com/en-us/materials/supplies/pens-markers)


**Other materials:**


- Tape or glue
- Crayons, markers, or colored pencils


## Free Thanksgiving designs from Cricut


To find Cricut’s selection of free Thanksgiving designs, start in Design Space and search terms like “Thanksgiving,” “turkey,” or “fall,” then use the Free filter under the Image search to find no-cost designs for your projects.[Cricut Access](https://cricut.com/en-us/join-cricut-access) members can also explore the wider collection of Thanksgiving projects and images included with their subscription. Availability changes, so always confirm the current “Free” or Cricut Access label in Design Space.


## Thanksgiving banners, signs, and shirts


Keep it collaborative and display-worthy. These Thanksgiving crafts are quick to personalize with names, a favorite color palette, or a message that fits your gathering.


### Thanksgiving banners and signs


Hang a “Give Thanks” banner above a buffet, make a welcome sign for the entryway, or add a layered design to a wood sign for a reusable fall accent. Cardstock and twine are great for a one-day banner, while adhesive vinyl works beautifully on a sign blank you’ll bring out each year.


Choose cardstock for lightweight paper banners, or use adhesive vinyl for signs. Not sure which material fits your project? Read[how to pick the right Cricut material for your project](https://cricut.com/blog/how-to-pick-the-right-cricut-material-for-your-project/) .

### Matching family Thanksgiving shirts


Matching family shirts make the holiday photo feel extra fun, whether everyone wears the same design or gets their own twist on the holiday shirts by adding their names, seasonal puns, or inside jokes and nicknames.


You can use Cricut Everyday Iron-On for adult tees, kids’ tees, sweatshirts, baby bodysuits, and more, or make the shirts even more elevated and fun with Metallic, Foil, and Glitter Iron-On. For all fabric projects, follow the recommended heat settings for your shirt material found in the[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/en-us/heatguide) . I’d suggest making a test cut first, especially for small lettering or detailed designs, and keep the design relatively simple if you plan to make large batches of shirts.

## Thanksgiving Crafts FAQs


####


Easy Thanksgiving crafts for kids include coloring placemats, paper turkeys, gratitude cards, and thankful trees or wreaths. Prepare the cut pieces in advance so younger makers can focus on coloring, writing, and gluing.


####


With[Cricut cutting machines](https://cricut.com/en-us/cutting-machines) , you can make Thanksgiving crafts such as kids’ activity sheets, turkey crafts, gratitude cards, banners, welcome signs, family Thanksgiving shirts, hand towels, drinkware decals, and hostess gifts. Browse Thanksgiving projects in Design Space for ready-to-make ideas.


And now, with[Cricut StickerPix machines](https://cricut.com/en-us/sticker-machines) , you can also create print-shop-quality invitations, menus, photo prints, leftover labels, and fun accent stickers for the kids’ table.


####


You can find free Thanksgiving designs in Cricut Design Space by searching “Thanksgiving,” “turkey,” or similar seasonal words and phrases and applying the Free filter. Check the item label before you add the image to your Design Space Canvas since availability and free options can change.


####


Toddlers can color pre-drawn or printed placemats, add stickers to pre-cut shapes, glue large paper turkey pieces, and share thankful thoughts for an adult to write. Always keep Cricut machines, other cutting tools, and small pieces with an adult.


####


Choose from the[Drawn Thanksgiving Activity Placemats](https://design-beta.cricut.com/home/inspiration-page-image-sets/6745947?navStateForLeftNavMenuOnCanvasTab=%252Fhome%252Fsearch%252Fsets-of-images&searchQuery=) image set from Design Space or create your own design, then use your Cricut cutting machine’s drawing functionality and compatible Cricut Pens and Markers to draw and cut each placemat. Once the placemats are completed, arrange them at the kids’ table and set out crayons or washable markers for the kids to use.


####


Find the images you’d like to use for a turkey body, head, beak, feet, and feather shapes in Design Space and cut those shapes out of cardstock using your Cricut cutting machine. Layer the pieces with glue or tape, then add an optional name, grateful note, or place-card tab.


####


Adults can personalize hand towels, wine glasses, shirts, signs, gift tags, and hostess gifts with Cricut vinyl, iron-on, cardstock, or Infusible Ink materials using a Cricut cutting machine.


For those looking to make print-shop-quality Friendsgiving invitations, menus, leftover labels, photo prints, and fun sticker accents for the kids’ table crafts, adults can use the new[Cricut StickerPix machines](https://cricut.com/en-us/sticker-machines) .


####


Cardstock is a great choice for paper turkeys, cards, and banners; printable paper works for activity sheets; iron-on works for shirts and textiles; and vinyl works for decals and signs. For help matching materials to your surface, see[how to pick the right Cricut material for your project](https://cricut.com/blog/how-to-pick-the-right-cricut-material-for-your-project/) .


Thanksgiving is a wonderful time to make something together. Browse Thanksgiving projects in[Design Space](https://design.cricut.com/) for ready-to-make ideas, then visit our[Thanksgiving table decor](https://cricut.com/blog/thanksgiving-crafts-with-cricut/) and[Thanksgiving centerpiece ideas](https://cricut.com/blog/showstopping-diy-thanksgiving-table-centerpieces/) posts when you’re ready to add hosting details to the celebration.
